title: Names of the 1918 war in Finnish Wikipedia's history-of-Finland articles, by snapshot date
unit: articles and mentions per name; shares are of the six names' mentions on that date
source: wtt.revision FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF each date (labs/history-of-history/war-names.sql)

columns.articles_total: articles that existed on the date
columns.articles: articles with at least one mention of the name anywhere in the wikitext
columns.other_countries: mentions qualified by another country (Viron vapaussota, Venäjän sisällissota ...)
columns.link_target: mentions inside the hidden target of a piped link [[target|label]]
columns.running_text: the rest: what a reader sees
columns.articles_running: articles with at least one running-text mention
columns.share_mentions: mentions / sum of mentions over the six names
columns.share_1918: mentions_1918 / sum over the six names
columns.share_running: running_text / sum over the six names
columns.seconds: wall time of the snapshot query
